summary: Review A of Phase 4 at b6326503 (phase base fc76c272) finds no blocking defect. coverCalmTopReport, cover-calm-top, deliverMuseCover, deliver-cover, and the commitDelivery refactor are correct. The week deliver path keeps its checks, its messages, and its write order. The plan closeout claims match the commits, the delivered files, and the person records. Five findings are nonblocking: the T171 timeout flake (P4-FLAKE-T171), the placeholder week and bookKind in the cover manifest, stale contract.md references, and two weak test assertions.
nonblocking_findings: RA-P4-1 [Major] review-a: P4-FLAKE-T171. tests/storytime-muse-delivery.test.ts has no vi.setConfig timeout. Only T181 (:1081) and T182 (:1145) set 240000 ms, and the other 38 tests use the 5000 ms default. T171 (:932) ran 5394 ms (orchestrator role-gate run, 10:33 ICT) and 5452 ms (closeout run 1), and it failed on timeout in both runs. The week-writer tests that decode 4000 x 3000 line prints (T161, T184 to T189) have no measured green duration, so they have the same risk. The cover tests T190 to T198 read only PNG metadata and have a lower risk. Remediation: add vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 30000, hookTimeout: 30000 }) at the top of the file, as tests/storytime-book-pictures.test.ts:100 does.

RA-P4-2 [Major] review-a: the cover manifest has misleading placeholder fields. coverJob (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:548-565) sets week 1, bookKind 'readalong', page 0, and empty text, sourcePrompt, sourcePackage, and sourceSha256. assembleManifest (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:2138-2139) copies week 1 and 'readalong' to the cover/color batch. The delivered out/storytime/l2/unit1/cover/delivery-muse-v1/manifest.json holds these values. The Level 2 cover is not a week 1 read-along page, and a consumer that groups by week or bookKind (for example Workbooks) will put the cover in week 1. contract.md does not document the cover manifest. size 'cover' and use 'cover' are correct (PICTURE_SIZES.cover is 4000 x 3000, class B). Remediation: document the cover manifest shape and the placeholder meaning of week and bookKind in contract.md, and tell Workbooks through the PM. Do not re-deliver only for this.

RA-P4-3 [Nit] review-a: contract.md is stale after 8c9a4082 and 6f7c1444. The Commands section (contract.md:43-107) does not name cover-calm-top or deliver-cover. The muse-delivery.ts line references at contract.md:74-99 point to old lines: for example ':444' is now :445, and ':456-459' and ':475-478' moved into commitDelivery (about :478-500). Remediation: add the two commands to contract.md and refresh the line references in the Phase 5 reconciliation task.

RA-P4-4 [Nit] review-a: the T192 'not a PNG' message check is vacuous. The pattern /png/i (tests/storytime-muse-delivery.test.ts:1584) always matches, because every refusal message names the print file l2-cover-v1-m13-color-print.png (src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts:587). The refusal itself stays pinned by rejection() and the 'writes no file' check. Remediation: match /must be a PNG/ instead of /png/i.

RA-P4-5 [Nit] review-a: T183 checks the band cases only against the 0.02 limit (tests/storytime-book-pictures.test.ts:4799-4800). A region that starts at row 1 instead of row 0 still gives 900 rows and the same four verdicts. The Red notes measured the exact shares (0.058988 and 0.111111). Remediation: assert the exact share of the band-inside case (400000 / 3600000) so that the test pins the start row.

The symlink root check, readMuseFile, and inspectColorPrint with PICTURE_SIZES.cover run before commitDelivery, so every check comes before the first write. mapReviews adds no review that the entry lacks.
